d:
This time on 'Guest in the Newsroom', our special guest is actor Aamir Khan.
In a candid conversation with Saurabh Dwivedi, Aamir opens up about his personal life, sharing heartfelt memories of his father, his bond with his mother, and his relationship with his ex-wife Reena. He also reflects on his journey as an actor — from the early days of Qayamat Se Qayamat Tak to the emotionally powerful Sitaare Zameen Par. Aamir talks about how he approached different characters over the years and what each role meant to him.
